Class Hdf5Group

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.hdf5.Hdf5Group
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Hdf5Group extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Thin wrapper around an HDF5 group handle. Created by Hdf5File.rootGroup() or by another group's createGroup(String)/openGroup(String).

Non-owning: the parent file's lifetime is retained by every group derived from it. All public methods acquire the appropriate lock from the owning file.

    • openDataset

      public Hdf5Dataset openDataset(String name)
      Open a named dataset in this group.

      Both Java-written 1-D datasets and N-D datasets written by other languages (e.g. Python h5py native 3-D layout for MSImage intensity cubes) are supported. The reported length is the product of all dimension extents.

      Parameters:
      name - the dataset name
      Returns:
      the opened dataset
      Throws:
      Hdf5Errors.DatasetOpenException - if the dataset is absent or cannot be opened

    • setStringAttribute

      public void setStringAttribute(String name, String value)
      Write a UTF-8 string attribute on this group.

      Emits a VL_STRING with UTF-8 character set so other-language readers (Python h5py, ObjC) consume the attribute byte-equivalently. Replaces any existing attribute of the same name regardless of its previous type.

      Parameters:
      name - the attribute name
      value - the UTF-8 string payload
